Proves EXACTLY ONE apply for the whole battle (the stage target appears once at scope lock) with stat=elemAdvantageDamagePct, self-scoped. Fails under a repeating trigger (count>1), under a team-wide target (extra applies to allies), and under a generic-stat encoding (stat assertion + the shared element-gate inertness counterfactual).

Magnitude-keyed counterfactual (strip any effect valued 46.93 or 91.09, any slot, any stat) must leave EVERY unit's total byte-identical, because Fire beats Wind so d has no advantage vs the control boss. This is the primary discriminator against the nearest-wrong generic Damage-Up encoding, which would move d's total under the same strip.

Stripping any effect with atkPct≈426.24 (encoding-agnostic) must lower d's total — fails if the burst damage is MISSING or mis-attributed. Paired inertness: no teammate total may move, which fails if the line were authored as an ally-facing effect or if it perturbs rotation/gauge.

Proves stat=partsDamagePct and class scoping (liter, a Supporter, never appears as a target), plus total-level inertness on the partless boss. Fails under the nearest-wrong promotion to attackDamagePct/damageTakenPct (which would move totals when stripped) and under an all-allies target set.

Stripping every fullBurstExtend effect must reduce the count of damage events flagged inFullBurst and must lower TEAM total damage with every teammate's total changing — the time-in-FB fraction 15/(C+5) exceeds 10/C for any cycle C>0, so the direction is monotonic. Fails if the line is MISSING, or if it were modeled as a self-only effect (teammates would not move).

fixtures: controlComp('d', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / d B3 / helm B3, Fire boss, focus d, deterministic (no seed). The fixed B3 (helm) is REQUIRED, not incidental: d's burst CD is 40s while the burst chain re-fires faster, so d cannot cast on every Full Burst, and that gap is what makes the fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast trigger test discriminate. 7 hoisted 180s runs: baseline + 6 encoding-agnostic counterfactuals (strip elem-adv magnitudes 46.93/91.09; strip 42.38; strip fillGauge; strip atkPct≈426.24; strip fullBurstExtend; re-key skill1 fullBurstEnter→burstCast). Every patch is matched on kit magnitude or effect kind and swept across all three slots, and slot access tolerates both the Block[] and CharacterSkills{blocks} slot shapes, so a blind shape/authoring guess can never silently turn a counterfactual into a no-op.
